mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, and ultimately resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high federal funds rates, or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 4% indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and spending, and ultimately resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with low unemployment rates, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate indicate a strong demand for goods and services, leading to increased production and economic growth, and ultimately resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong housing starts and low unemployment rates, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates an increase in the supply of goods and services, leading to decreased prices and increased demand, and ultimately resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with strong industrial production growth, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply indicate an easing monetary cycle, leading to increased borrowing and spending, and ultimately resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with low federal funds rates and high money supply growth, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and spending, and ultimately resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong payroll employment growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index indicates decreased demand for goods and services, leading to decreased production and economic growth, and ultimately resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with low consumer price index values, or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
